newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks to let brokerage clients use ATM-paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks to let brokerage clients use ATM-paper.

text.p: Ten of Japan's major commercial banks have agreed to allow clients of securities houses to withdraw money and check their deposit balances through their nationwide automatic teller machine (ATM) networks, a Japanese daily said on Thursday.
The Asahi Shimbun said the banking industry would notify the Japan Securities Dealers Association soon about the decision.
Brokerage clients would be able to use the ATM networks of the 10 banks by the end of next year.
Securities houses initially hoped to have access to the ATMS of all commercial banks in Japan, but the banks rejected that, saying it would not benefit their clients much, the paper said.
The Asahi did not specify which 10 banks were involved.
Banking industry sources were not immediately available for comment on the report.
